answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 16011 Country: India Title: as salamalaikum. i want to know a person who is involved in finance and intrest business can give azaan in masjid...pls reply asap Question: as salamalaikum. i want to know a person who is involved in finance and intrest business can give azaan in masjid...pls reply asap Answer ID: 16011 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1468/1466=M=1430) For a Muslim it is haram and unlawful to join an interest based business. Therefore, such a person should avoid calling azan in mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
